title: Busy week for Cebuano athletes vying for Philippines in the Asian Games

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The 20th Asian Games in Nagoya and Aichi, Japan, are now in full swing following the colorful opening ceremony on Saturday, September 19, with several Cebuano athletes already plunging into action for the Philippine delegation. Cebuano triathletes, footballers, beach volleyball players, and volleyball players have already seen action and completed their competitions. The busy schedule will continue on Monday, September 21, with several Cebuano athletes returning to competition in different venues across Nagoya and Aichi.
